# Test Fixtures

Keep this directory clean.

Allowed here:

- tiny synthetic binary snippets;
- redacted minimal byte slices;
- JSON expected outputs from fake data.

Forbidden here:

- full `.sav` / `.dsv` files;
- ROMs;
- BIOS files;
- personal saves.

Local smoke tests may use Alberto's machine paths and skip when missing. Do not copy those saves into this directory. The puppy is watching.
